title: Winspace SLC 3.0 2000km later... Great Bike - No wonder FIAT's are crap

takeaways.text: He weighed the fork at 418 g and the seatpost at 182 g, and said the frame is around 820 g; frame size and included hardware are not stated.
Touch points and brake mounts were dressed and checked flat with a rule; the BB86 shell measured about 40.95–41.0 mm and was faced, and the inside is clean EPS-moulded work.
From the flared chainstays he reckons 32 mm tires would fit; this is his inspection estimate.
The only fault was the FSA ACR headset: the top bearing bore measured about 42.08 mm instead of 42 mm, leaving play. Winspace UK sent a replacement in under 24 hours.
The frame is compact, so sizing takes care; with long legs and a short torso he needed extra spacers.
The ride is soft and silky, mostly because of the long, thin round 27.2 mm seatpost; overall he rates it a very good bike.
He advises against 30 mm or DUB-axle cranks in the BB86 shell because the small bearings and thin surrounding structure take more load.

disclosure: Engineer-led inspection and 2,000 km ride review; how he obtained the frame is not stated, and Winspace UK replaced a headset bearing.
summary: Hambini inspects the Winspace SLC3.0 frameset, measures its tolerances and reports after about 2,000 km.
